verification.precondition: The canonical authoring protocol, candidate phase protocol, and independent paired-state matrix exist.
verification.stimulus: Validate all thirty-eight canonical pairs and compare the complete ordered pair/class set with the independently constructed semantic expectation.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The legal pair authority includes every mainline state, both correction targets and their sources, coupled abort closure, and terminal success closure.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: node:test reports the literal assertion: the canonical paired-state matrix contains the full legal mainline, correction, abort, and terminal set
verification.forbiddenMutation: The test must not infer an unlisted pair, broaden a phase range, or modify either owning state machine.

behavior: the canonical paired-state matrix contains the full legal mainline, correction, abort, and terminal set
